a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
rows=[4,12,20,28,36,44,52]; cols=[6,14,22,30,38,46,54]
R,C=7,7
subs={}; exists={}
for i in range(R):
    for j in range(C):
        if i==0 and j==6: continue
        blk=''.join(a[rows[i]+x][cols[j]:cols[j]+6] for x in range(6))
        if set(blk)=={'c'}: continue
        exists[(i,j)]=True
        subs[(i,j)]=[[a[rows[i]+2*x][cols[j]+2*y] for y in range(3)] for x in range(3)]
keys=[k for k,v in subs.items() if len(set(''.join(''.join(s) for s in v)))>1]
from collections import defaultdict
targets=defaultdict(set)
bad=[]
for (ki,kj) in keys:
    kc=subs[(ki,kj)][1][1]
    for x in range(3):
        for y in range(3):
            ci,cj=ki+x-1,kj+y-1
            if (ci,cj) not in exists or (ci,cj) in keys: continue
            s=subs[(ki,kj)][x][y]
            if s=='G': bad.append(('G on real cell',(ki,kj),(ci,cj))); continue
            if s in (kc,'g'): t=kc
            elif s in ('W','M'): t='p' if kc=='N' else 'N'
            else: bad.append(('unknown sub',s,(ki,kj),(ci,cj))); continue
            targets[(ci,cj)].add(t)
conf=[(k,v) for k,v in sorted(targets.items()) if len(v)>1]
print('conflicts:',conf)
print('uncovered non-key cells:',sorted(set(exists)-set(keys)-set(targets)))
pcells=sorted([k for k,v in targets.items() if v=={'p'}])
ncells=sorted([k for k,v in targets.items() if v=={'N'}])
print('target p cells:',len(pcells),pcells)
print('target N cells:',len(ncells))
print('keys:',len(keys))
